steps: Drain the soaked whole urad and rajma and pressure cook them in fresh water until very soft.
Mash some of the dal lightly with a spoon.
Heat the ghee with the bay leaf and fry the onion until golden.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for a minute.
Add the tomato, chilli powder, garam masala and salt and cook until the fat shows at the edges.
Add the dal with its water and simmer on low for 45 to 90 minutes, stirring often and adding hot water as it thickens.
Stir in the crushed kasuri methi and the cream.
Turn off the heat and mix in the butter.
note: Both sources agree closely, at about 52 g of dry dal and beans a person. Cumin, green chilli, oil and coriander leaves are gone because neither source uses them.
